patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: (Friend) I found him slumped over and I couldn't wake him up. He's barely breathing — really slow. There were pills around. Please help him.
clinical.presentationShort: 32yo M — depressed LOC, RR 6, pinpoint pupils, cyanotic, suspected opioid overdose — give naloxone.
clinical.presentationLong: 32-year-old male, minimally responsive with a respiratory rate of 6, pinpoint pupils, and cyanosis — opioid overdose requiring immediate naloxone and airway support.

diagnosis.disposition: Resus → bag-valve-mask, naloxone, airway support, monitor for re-narcotization; screen co-ingestants.
diagnosis.why: Slow breathing + pinpoint pupils + unresponsive = opioids. Oxygen/BVM first, then naloxone; watch for it wearing off.
diagnosis.redFlag: RR 6 + pinpoint pupils + low SpO2 = opioid toxidrome; ventilate and give naloxone now.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: slumped limply, head lolling, eyes closed
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 32-year-old man, pale with a bluish tint, slumped limply on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: slumped with his head lolling and eyes closed, unconscious. Expression: slack and unresponsive. Clearly visible: a limp posture and pale, bluish lips. No text, no logos.
